title: Clean up divide-by-zero errors with IFERROR
objective: Wrap a division in IFERROR so that a zero divisor shows a readable message instead of #DIV/0!.
instructions: Sell-through is units sold divided by units received. In E2:E6 work it out, but show "No stock" when the division gives an error. Stock cover in weeks is stock left (received minus sold) divided by weekly unit sales. In F2:F6 work it out, but show "No sales" when the division gives an error. Sell-through is stored as a decimal, so 0.07 means 7%.
hints: Start with the plain division: =C2/B2. For Mombasa it shows #DIV/0! because nothing was received.
IFERROR(value, value_if_error) shows the second argument when the first is an error: =IFERROR(C2/B2,"No stock").
For cover, put the whole division inside IFERROR: =IFERROR((B2-C2)/D2,"No sales"). The brackets make the subtraction happen first.
